principle: FACILITY TYPE != FACILITY DESIGN != INDIVIDUAL FACILITY != OWNER != OPERATOR != CURRENT FUNCTION

individual_facility.meaning: Persistent world entity with facility_id and history.

ownership.meaning: Legal/property or sovereign owner; may change.

operation.meaning: Organization currently running the facility; may differ from owner.

assignment_profile.meaning: Current mission/service role; can change without rebuilding the whole facility.

rules: One design can produce multiple individual facilities when its reuse policy permits.
One individual facility can change owner/operator/mission without changing facility_id.
A major physical refit changes configuration/topology version, not identity.
A captured facility retains original physical design until changed by explicit refit/reconstruction.
A facility's current function may be narrower or broader than the design's original role.
